questions.question: What did Esther reveal at the second banquet?
options: That Haman planned to destroy her people
Only the name of her Jewish family
A secret plan to defend the whole kingdom
The full extent of her royal wealth
questions.answer: That Haman planned to destroy her people

questions.question: What happened to Haman?
options: He fled away from the palace out into the dark night
He was sent away into exile in a land far away
He was pardoned by the king and kept his high office
He was hanged on the gallows he made for Mordecai
questions.answer: He was hanged on the gallows he made for Mordecai
